Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo currently May 18 — travel conflict

Hi Irene,

Quick note — we really want to see the Redwood demo, but our VP of Data (Rahul) just locked travel for May 17–19 for an on-site investor meeting. That means the May 18slot you proposed will be tough for us to get the right stakeholders in the room.

Two asks: can we shift the demo so we have time to share sample data and prompt examples beforehand (Rahul likes to see a few tailored prompts ahead of time), and can we avoid May 17–19? We prefer week of May 24 or early June.

Also cc'ing contracts so they see any timing changes for SOW/PO planning.

Thanks — Anna

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Redwood demo currently May 18 — travel conflict

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads-up and for looping in contracts.

We can absolutely move the session — and we agree it's critical that your team has time to:
- upload sample traces / sanitized sample data,
- review a short set of curated prompts we'll use in the demo, and
- confirm SSO & IAM access for the evaluation accounts.

Proposed options (all PDT):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:00 (internal dry-run the week prior)
- Thu May 27, 14:00–15:00 (buffer for travel on 26th)
- Wed Jun 2, 11:00–12:00 (safe option if stakeholders prefer early June)

Next steps I recommend so we don't have last-minute blockers:
1) We send a short prep checklist and a S3/Drive upload path for sample data (we'll scrub logs; nothing leaves your tenancy).
2) Marissa will own the prompt set review; can you share 3–5 representative prompts by Tue May 18?
3) Dev will reach out to your IdP admin to validate SSO mapping; if possible share a contact.

I've cc'd Marissa and Dev to coordinate the prep items; Sergio is on this thread as an exec sponsor to keep timelines aligned with the deal.

Which of the three dates works best for you? If none, please propose 2–3 alternatives.

Best,
Irene

Subject: Confirmed: Demo moved to Wed Jun 2 — dry-run & prep next steps

Hi Anna / Contracts team — thanks for the quick replies and for surfacing Rahul's travel calendar.

Let's lock Wed Jun 2, 11:00–12:00 PDT for the live demo. To avoid last-minute blockers, here's what we'll do and timelines:

Prep checklist (attached: prep-checklist.xlsx):
- Share 3–5 representative prompts by Tue May 18 (Finlytics)
- Upload sanitized sample traces + 3 example payloads to the shared Drive folder by Fri May 21 (link below)
- Confirm SSO admin contact by Mon May 17 so Dev can validate mapping
- Security artifacts for pre-review: retention policy excerpt, SOC 2 cert link, minimal data flow diagram (we'll provide a template) — please target May 21 for those

Dry-run: we propose Tue May 26, 10:00–11:00 PDT for an internal dry-run (Marissa + Dev + Irene + 2 Finlytics engineers). This will be a technical rehearsal to validate sample data ingestion, model prompt behavior, and console access. If Rahul can't make the dry-run, that's ok — we primarily need your engineers.

Attachments included: prep-checklist.xlsx, dryrun-runbook.pdf (stubs).

Logistics & links:
- Prep assets folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prep-assets
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/contacts/FIN-0821
- Scheduling page to finalize invite: https://app.redwood.com/schedules/FIN-2027-0821

If any of the timelines above are painful for procurement or security, please flag now and we'll adjust. Otherwise I'll send calendar invites for Jun 2 and the May 26 dry-run by EOD Thurs May 13.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
